title: On the Ekedahl sieve for the singular locus of the discriminant polynomial
summary: The Ekedahl sieve is a powerful tool for enumerating arithmetic objects, but traditional formulations relying on inductive steps often yield suboptimal bounds when applied to highly skew boxes. This limitation is particularly restrictive when introducing large modular conditions that compete with the tail-end variables of a binary form. In this paper, we develop a specialized variant of the Ekedahl sieve tailored to the singular locus of the discriminant polynomial.
